title: Beyond the Sink Token: Sink-Guided Key Editing in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In vision-language models (VLMs), a few sink tokens attract a disproportionate share of attention. While previous studies have examined why these tokens attract attention, we investigate how the sink-key direction affects attention to image and question tokens. Across four probed VLMs, boosting the magnitude of positive sink-aligned components increases attention on average, whereas boosting negative components decreases it; these responses persist through later layers. This identifies the native sink key as a reference for controlling attention beyond its own position. Motivated by this finding, we propose SHRINK, a training-free method that partially reduces sink-aligned components across visible keys during generation. translated_title: 超越汇聚Token：视觉语言模型中基于汇聚引导的键编辑
translated_abstract: 在视觉语言模型（VLM）中，少数“汇聚token”吸引了不成比例的注意力份额。以往的研究探讨了这些token为何会吸引注意力，而我们则研究汇聚键方向如何影响对图像token和问题token的注意力。在四个被探测的VLM上，增强正的汇聚对齐分量的幅度平均会增加注意力，而增强负分量则会降低注意力；这种响应在后续网络层中持续存在。这表明原生汇聚键可以作为控制其自身位置之外注意力的参考基准。基于这一发现，我们提出了SHRINK，一种无需训练的方法，在生成过程中部分削减可见键中的汇聚对齐分量。在九个基准的采样推理测试中，该方法在LLaVA-OneVision-7B和Qwen2.5-VL-3B上分别将平均准确率提升了5.1和2.7个百分点，在另外两个主要模型Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Gemma-（摘要截断）上也有较小提升。
tldr: 该论文发现VLM中的汇聚键方向可作为调控其他位置注意力的参考，并提出无需训练的SHRINK方法，通过在生成时削减可见键中的汇聚对齐分量，在多个基准上显著提升了模型准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the sink-key direction in VLMs serves as a reference for modulating attention beyond its own position, and proposes SHRINK, a training-free method that reduces sink-aligned components in visible keys during generation, improving accuracy across multiple benchmarks.
